definitions.explanation: The desire to deeply investigate and understand things; a curious and questioning mindset.

examples.japanese: {探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: They are a person with strong intellectual curiosity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: To nurture children's spirit of inquiry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Scientists need a spirit of inquiry.

notes:
{探究心|たんきゅうしん} combines ⟦{探究|たんきゅう}→探究：12902_tankyuu⟧ (inquiry, investigation) + ⟦{心|しん}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (mind, spirit). It describes a deep intellectual drive to understand things thoroughly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to foster a spirit of inquiry
- {探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧: to have a strong curiosity
- {探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: filled with curiosity
- {探究心|たんきゅうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: having strong intellectual curiosity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧: curiosity (broader — can include casual or passing interest)
- ⟦{向上心|こうじょうしん}→向上心：11897_koujoushin⟧: desire for self-improvement
- {探求心|たんきゅうしん}: also "spirit of inquiry" (using {求|きゅう} instead of {究|きゅう} — similar meaning but {探究|たんきゅう} emphasizes deeper investigation)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Often used in educational and academic contexts.
